groups.label: Planning notes
items: Required workdays, non-required workdays, district professional development days, and annual leave are days when students do not attend school unless BCS announces a make-up change.
BCS notes that calendar changes may use early-release days or Saturdays, so check district and school announcements after weather closures.
The published traditional calendar lists 2028 graduation dates as TBD; confirm times and locations with BCS and the student’s school.

calendarFaqs.q: Which BCS calendar is shown on this page?
calendarFaqs.a: This page summarizes the 2027–28 BCS traditional calendar. Early College students will follow a separate calendar tied to the Brunswick Community College calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the status of the BCS 2027–28 Early College calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: BCS says the 2027–28 Early College calendar will follow the Brunswick Community College calendar and will be available in Spring 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are BCS workdays days off for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Required workdays, non-required workdays, and district professional development days are days when students do not attend school unless BCS announces a make-up change.

calendarFaqs.q: When do BCS students return after winter break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are off December 20, 2027 through January 4, 2028. The next regular school day is Wednesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Brunswick County Schools graduation dates in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The published 2027–28 traditional calendar lists the graduation schedule as TBD. Check BCS and school announcements for final dates, times, and locations.
Yes. Weather, board action, or instructional-time needs may change the calendar. Check the official BCS printable calendars page and school announcements before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official BCS 2027–28 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link on this page or the BCS printable calendars page to view the district’s published 2027–28 traditional calendar.
